prompts.floor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: in-game 2D top-down pixel-art arena background atlas, NOT a mockup or screenshot. Reference image is mood only. Generate ONE atlas with TWO equal rectangular panels stacked vertically, no borders/labels: top panel colorful living gothic stone courtyard, bottom panel EXACTLY THE SAME courtyard and geometry rendered near-monochrome cold grey for stopped time. Each panel is a broad 5:3 arena, full image portrait 5:6. True top-down orthographic overhead floor, NOT isometric, NOT side-scrolling. Floor must be flat and walkable with at least central85% open and low contrast: worn square cobblestones, faint concentric clock/compass engraving in center. Decoration only in outer narrow margin: pale gothic stone trim, scattered tiny ivy and pink petals, a few warm amber lamps. No large walls or pillars or objects inside the play area, no stairs, no characters/enemies/UI/text/healthbars. Colored panel: restrained teal-blue stone, subtle warm amber accents, burgundy-pink petals, hints of magenta anomaly near upper/right edge. Frozen panel: same identical flat floor design almost greyscale with greatly reduced saturation. This is backdrop underneath actual collision walls and gameplay sprites. Strong pixel art, crisp small detail, chunky consistent pixels, atmospheric but clean and readable. No rendered perspective, no dramatic camera, no labels. Existing white-headed burgundy hero and magenta enemies need to stand out, so center floor is much quieter than concept art. Fill both panels edge-to-edge.
prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready top-down chibi pixel-art enemy sprite atlas on transparent background. Reference is mood/palette only; keep far simpler than concept. ONE image divided into THREE EQUAL vertical cells in one horizontal row, exactly three separate complete enemy sprites, consistent tiny64x64 pixel-art logical style, common feet baseline and centered in cells. No text/labels/grid/floor/shadow, true alpha. LEFT: small corrupted archer-sentry, dark slate hood, single glowing magenta eye/core, small bow/staff; compact readable rounded silhouette. MIDDLE: fast melee hunter knight, dark blue-grey armor, short magenta blade, burgundy torn scarf, low aggressive silhouette. RIGHT: larger corrupted mini-boss gatekeeper, broad slate armour, small spiked crown, huge glowing hot-magenta chest core, asymmetrical shield arm, unmistakable broad silhouette. White highlights very restrained; threats glow magenta; dark indigo/charcoal armor. 2D top-down game sprite view with slightly visible front like a small Zelda character, no realistic rendering, no antialiasing, no painterly effects. Keep sprite bodies complete and widely separated, all inside their own equal cells. One neutral idle pose each, weapon not swinging. Do not reproduce or redesign the player's blank white square-headed hero.

notes: Draft generated game art. Import only slices/resizes panels and normalizes alpha canvases; no player designer art replaced.
